newsitem.title: INDIA: India to quicken approval for electronics ventures.
newsitem.headline: India to quicken approval for electronics ventures.

text.p: India will grant approval within 15 days instead of the current one month those applications for Electronics Hardware Technology Parks (EHTP) and Software Technology Parks (STP) which fulfill all conditions, according to a government statement on Monday.
EHTP and STP schemes give incentives in the form of tax breaks to electronics hardware and software exporters.

To be eligible for fast approval, applicants would need to locate their units in specified zones and ensure that the CIF (cost-insurance-freight) value of imported goods is under 100 million rupees ($2.8 million), the statement said.

Applicants would also have to ensure that knowhow fees for technical assistance do not exceed $2 million, and royalty does not exceed eight percent on exports and five percent on local sales within five years of starting operations, the statement said.

The statement also said existing units could get this status if they fulfilled all the criteria. Post-approval amendments would also be made for applicants and would be dealt with by the officials in charge of each STP or EHTP.
